How much does a mortgage broker cost in Wollongong? Most mortgage broker services are free for borrowers. Brokers are paid by lenders through commissions (typically 0.65-0.70% upfront, 0.15% trail annually). Fees may apply for complex or commercial loans in some cases – this will always be disclosed upfront. Do I need a mortgage broker to buy a house? Not required, but highly beneficial. Over 75% of Australian home loans now go through brokers (MFAA data). Brokers compare multiple lenders, save you time, and must legally act in your best interests under the Best Interests Duty. What is the difference between a finance broker and a mortgage broker? A mortgage broker focuses primarily on home loans. A finance broker handles a wider range of products: home loans, commercial finance, equipment finance, car loans, and more. Our Wollongong network offers both services.
